_ztardvst: Gideon Ztardvst walked into P-F20 on Day 11 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gideon Ztardvst helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Gideon Ztardvst fired, and Marek Kha was grazed. A letter from home found Gideon Ztardvst before the night shift. Gideon Ztardvst folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon Ztardvst had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. A letter from home found Gideon Ztardvst before the night shift. Gideon Ztardvst folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Gideon Ztardvst was carrying water up to P-F20 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Gideon Ztardvst did not. A letter from home found Gideon Ztardvst before the night shift. Gideon Ztardvst folded it small and kept it close.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Gideon Ztardvst. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Wendel Ztardvst took the same post at P-F20 where Gideon Ztardvst stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Wendel Ztardvst threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo was down and screaming for a medic. (@andrewcraddock1980) Wendel Ztardvst came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Wendel Ztardvst was on the dawn watch at P-F20 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Wendel Ztardvst was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Benedikt Theoneonlyfi of the Concord (@theoneonlyfishboy). Wendel Ztardvst got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

The medic cut the last bandage off Wendel Ztardvst's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to P-F20 the same hour. A letter for Wendel Ztardvst came with a pressed flower inside. Wendel Ztardvst showed the flower to nobody.

Wendel saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at P-F20 and fired once. Nils Thegremillio was grazed. Wendel took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at P-F20, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Dietrich Dalton of the Concord (@zeek.dalton). A letter came for Wendel from the man who owns the shop back home. It said Wendel's job would be waiting. Wendel read that line to the squad.
a.s26221: Arno "Doc" As unpacked a child's drawing of a horse at R-C5. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. The new duty roster listed Arno "Doc" As as a signaller. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

In the dark of the Concord trench Arno "Doc" As hit Silas Joha with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@joha123477) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Arno "Doc" As landed next to Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar in the Concord trench. Only Arno "Doc" As climbed back out. (@max.kattawar) Blackwater Canal has been won. Arno "Doc" As listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno "Doc" As. Arno "Doc" As read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The line to the battery keeps going dead at the same spot near the Ossuary Wood. Arno "Doc" As suspects it is not the shelling. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno "Doc" As is number 796. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-C5 changed before the cheering ended. Arno "Doc" As shouldered another load.
Arno "Parson" Theverb (Concord) and Arno "Doc" As (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Grey Mill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Arno "Doc" As shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Arno "Doc" As crawled out along the wire at night and found the break: neat, cut, recent. Someone is listening in.
The telephone wire to R-C5 was cut by shelling four times. Arno "Doc" As crawled out and spliced it four times.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Arno "Doc" As was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Arno "Doc" As laid a second line, deep, by a different route, and left the old one live with false orders on it. Tomorrow the enemy shells an empty farm.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Arno asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
alexgreve: Norbert Alexgreve arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying his brother's pocket watch and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Norbert Alexgreve across the shin at R-R3. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Dorian Heitoralmeid of the Hegemony (@heitoralmeida314). Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Norbert Alexgreve watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Norbert Alexgreve no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Norbert Alexgreve got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 955. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-R3 with the rations. Norbert Alexgreve ate while listening to the revised orders.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Norbert Alexgreve's ear at R-R3 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt of the Hegemony (@tiberiuswt).
The wound on Norbert Alexgreve's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Norbert Alexgreve tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Rosenau. Every version sounded like the ration bell.

Norbert Alexgreve was carrying water up to R-R3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Norbert Alexgreve did not. Shot by Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam of the Hegemony (@falloutvam).
A medic brought Norbert Alexgreve half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Norbert Alexgreve never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
In the rear quarters, Norbert played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated.
anthony_paz: After 10 days of war, Q-F9 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Walter Paz.

Walter Paz bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter Paz watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Walter Paz lent Cyril Catatfire a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
At Q-F9 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Walter Paz won the bet. Marek Himself was badly wounded.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Walter Paz's ear at Q-F9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Oskar Himself of the Concord (@mr.fartpants.himself).
Back on the fire step at Q-F9. Walter Paz says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

A bullet went through Walter Paz's upper arm at Q-F9 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Oskar Himself of the Concord (@mr.fartpants.himself). Walter Paz was killed outright at Q-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Oskar Himself of the Concord (@mr.fartpants.himself).
Leopold Paz arrived carrying the family name of Walter Paz. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Leopold Paz began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Leopold was reaching for a canteen at Q-F9 when a round tore the strap in two. It also tore a line across his hand. Shot by Cyril Raptor of the Concord (@furry_raptor3945).
heartbreaking_motives: Konrad Motives arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
ibanez.solano: On Day 10 Felix Solano took a post at Q-F18 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it.

Felix Solano felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F18. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto of the Concord (@taylociraptor). Grey Mill has been won. Felix Solano listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Felix Solano's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Felix Solano wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.
The wind carried away the last words of every order. Felix Solano waited until the corporal came closer before picking up anything heavy.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Felix Solano said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Someone in Q-F18 asked Felix Solano about Port Abel. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Felix Solano of the Hegemony and Henrik Youknowsomet of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Bone Quarry all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Felix was reaching for a canteen at Q-F18 when a round tore the strap in two. It also tore a line across his hand. Shot by Marek Jake of the Concord (@jake_81590).
incongruent.yeti: Ulrich Yeti came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Ulrich Yeti watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Ulrich Yeti traded a bullet that missed him for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. Grey Mill is lost. Ulrich Yeti heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Ulrich Yeti of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Saint-Ash crossroads. Albin "Shadow" Cymru of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
Ulrich Maliklee of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Ulrich Yeti kept the tin.
Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam lent Ulrich Yeti a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Ulrich Son and Ulrich Yeti carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

Ulrich Yeti felt a hard tug at his hip at T-F18. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Matthias Dinomebattic of the Hegemony (@ilpappa_dinomebatticulo).

Ulrich Yeti was hit through the chest at T-F18. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis of the Hegemony (@ihatethis1988). Ulrich Yeti was killed on watch at T-F18. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis of the Hegemony (@ihatethis1988).
The papers say Tobias Yeti. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Ulrich Yeti's eyes. Nobody in T-F18 argues.
A clear shot from T-F18. Tobias gravely wounded Otto Fatherflowst and slid back down below the parapet.
jackpriv11g: Gustav Jackpriv stepped off the supply cart at V-F8 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Gustav Jackpriv. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home reached Gustav Jackpriv before dusk. Gustav Jackpriv read it twice and slept a little easier.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Gustav Jackpriv ate two helpings anyway. A letter from home reached Gustav Jackpriv before dusk. Gustav Jackpriv read it twice and slept a little easier.

At V-F8 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Gustav Jackpriv turned around and took a shovel blow. Valentin Nothing of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Valentin Nothing of the Concord (@nothing_va1). A letter for Gustav Jackpriv came with a pressed flower inside. Gustav Jackpriv showed the flower to nobody.

Gustav Jackpriv's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. Gustav Jackpriv read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.

For days Gustav was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. A thin letter reached Gustav. Only five lines long, and Gustav knew every one of them by heart before supper.
jankiedestroyer: By the time Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro reached Q-F8, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F8 with the rations. Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro ate while listening to the revised orders.
Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro and Silas Menac split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro's ear at Q-F8 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Casimir Nshill of the Hegemony (@nshill429).
The medic cut the last bandage off Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to Q-F8 the same hour.
Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at Q-F8. Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Ulrich Ljuliolemosl of the Hegemony (@ljuliolemosl).
Ulrich "Crow" Jankiedestro joined Q-F8 under the shadow of Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Ulrich "Crow" Jankiedestro caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
Ulrich was handed a note with no address. He asked around for an hour and delivered it to a man who cried.
jonathan.beard02: Viktor "Doc" Beard found a place in N-F22 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Viktor "Doc" Beard said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.

Viktor was hit in the hip at N-F22. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Gideon Phosphor of the Concord (@white__phosphor). Viktor was killed at N-F22 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot.
Severin "Whistle" Beard asked about Viktor "Doc" Beard on arriving at N-F22. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
klecka2617: Teodor Klecka came up with a draft of replacements on Day 6. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it. Victory at Hill 304. Teodor Klecka let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Teodor Klecka hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint. A letter from home reached Teodor Klecka before dusk. Teodor Klecka read it twice and slept a little easier.

Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Teodor Klecka waited under a load that got heavier by the minute. A letter from home reached Teodor Klecka before dusk. Teodor Klecka read it twice and slept a little easier.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Teodor Klecka lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Teodor Klecka traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Teodor Klecka wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Teodor Klecka was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S10. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Roland Potato of the Concord (@combat_potato1). The clerk counted the names twice. Teodor Klecka is number 373 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Teodor Klecka folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Three days with a bandage, and Teodor Klecka is back at S-S10. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Teodor Klecka checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
A bullet hit Teodor Klecka's belt buckle at S-S10 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ulrich Axelat of the Concord (@axelat3).

Teodor Klecka was hit in the hip at S-S10. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Karel Stefan of the Concord (@mar.stefan16). Teodor Klecka was killed outright at S-S10, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Karel Stefan of the Concord (@mar.stefan16).
Hugo Klecka had heard about Teodor Klecka's courage. At S-S10, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Fresh from training, Hugo Klecka still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Nils Jacobflamber, gravely wounded. Hugo Klecka fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Oskar Pbscn was gravely wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Hugo Klecka said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Hugo was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
lammyswashy: Roland Lammyswashy arrived on Day 11 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Roland Lammyswashy and Pavel Mcm divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Roland Lammyswashy read a theatre review while peeling supper.
Roland Lammyswashy shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Roland Lammyswashy saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

During a lull at the Brickworks, Severin Montblackz called across from the Hegemony line. Roland Lammyswashy answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Roland Lammyswashy (Concord) and Konrad Hammerthyste (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at Lantern Hill at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Roland carried three men out of N-F18 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
mau.mars_: The sergeant gave Jonas Mars a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 11 or any other. Orders assigned Jonas Mars to work as a runner. The first lesson began with what not to touch. After the loss of Grey Mill, Jonas Mars helped stack spare sandbags at N-F15. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Jonas Mars lent Hugo Panda a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Jonas Mars ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Jonas Mars's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Jonas Mars said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
A second spoon disappeared. Jonas Mars searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
Jonas Mars lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing.
Jonas borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
nazareth_2bc: In Dunmarrow, Edmund "Saint" Nazareth was a ferryman. In R-C14, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a ferryman again.

On dawn watch at R-C14, Edmund "Saint" Nazareth fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Quentin "Shadow" Danny, now grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Edmund "Saint" Nazareth during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Edmund "Saint" Nazareth fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-C14. Bastian Arvidgrubb was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Edmund "Saint" Nazareth got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 907. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Edmund "Saint" Nazareth did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
After the shelling at R-C14, nobody could account for Edmund "Saint" Nazareth. His kit remains beside the bunk.
The missing report was still on the desk when Edmund "Saint" Nazareth walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Edmund "Saint" Nazareth said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Edmund "Saint" Nazareth was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was gravely wounded.
Officers came to inspect R-C14. Edmund "Saint" Nazareth polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Edmund "Saint" Nazareth spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

A bullet went through Edmund's forearm at R-C14. The bone held, but the hand would not close. Two men carried him to the aid post. Shot by Silas Wumpus of the Concord (@flumpus.wumpus). Edmund was shot dead at R-C14 while looking over the parapet. The squad did not move for an hour.
Florian Nazareth had heard about Edmund "Saint" Nazareth's courage. At R-C14, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
noaskevitch: Nils Noaskevitch reported to S-F2 with a photograph gone soft at the edges sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Nils Noaskevitch took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.

Nils Noaskevitch and Wendel Jesus compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. Victory at Hill 304. Nils Noaskevitch let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Nils Noaskevitch marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.
Nils Noaskevitch can fall asleep anywhere, instantly. Today, under fire at the Hanging Bridge, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F2.
Someone removed the spoon from Nils Noaskevitch's junction to eat supper. He retrieved it and nailed it above comfortable reaching height.
A new runner delivered a message using Spoon Corner and Boot Turn without hesitation. Nils Noaskevitch drew both markers on the official route sketch.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Nils Noaskevitch only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F2, then nothing but pain. Raider: Dorian Coloradoforw of the Concord (@coloradoforwardblake). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Nils Noaskevitch helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Nils Noaskevitch's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Nils Noaskevitch is number 272. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Nils Noaskevitch during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Nils Noaskevitch survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-F2, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
Nils Noaskevitch taught Anselm Perry three words in the language of home. Anselm uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
Nils Noaskevitch spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Nils Noaskevitch delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.
A single shot from across the wire hit Nils Noaskevitch in the thigh at S-F2. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Rafael Carwyn of the Concord (@carwyn1988).
Nils Noaskevitch lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
When Nils returned to S-F2, the squad had kept his spot. He thanked them with the last of his tobacco.
padraiggallagher: By the time Tobias Padraiggalla reached S-C13, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Tobias Padraiggalla helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot and Tobias Padraiggalla compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Tobias Padraiggalla is number 960. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Tobias Padraiggalla during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Tobias Padraiggalla read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Karel Bachini's name scratched on it. Tobias Padraiggalla kicked it back. It did not come again.
Tobias Padraiggalla carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it.
Tobias Padraiggalla obtained a recipe for a simple onion bread. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Tobias Padraiggalla accepted it as a review.
Rafael Schmidty and Tobias Padraiggalla divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Ivo "Saint" Klaymore wrote a song about Lantern Hill. Tobias Padraiggalla wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
victor__combs: By the time Edmund Combs reached Q-F2, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Edmund Combs rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Hugo "Brick" Alex was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land. Grey Mill has been won. Edmund Combs listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Edmund Combs could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water.
Edmund Combs and Silas Isaiahfs cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Edmund Combs reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F2 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Roland Alex of the Concord (@alex_h5315).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Edmund Combs is whole again, or near enough for the line.
No rifles, only shovels and knives. Edmund Combs dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Emil Lutheranapol coming out. It was over in seconds. (@lutheranapologist)

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Edmund Combs was faster. Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes was grazed. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-F2 and grazed Edmund Combs's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix Barringarms of the Concord (@tac_sloth_barringarms).
Back on the fire step at Q-F2. Edmund says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
xboxme3e: Severin Xboxme came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A round went through Severin Xboxme's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Silas Nthuff of the Concord (@nthuff66). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Severin Xboxme helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Xboxme. Severin Xboxme read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Severin Xboxme took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at Q-F13, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Karel Tom of the Concord (@tom_w372). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Severin Xboxme fell at Q-F13 and never moved again. Shot by Karel Tom of the Concord (@tom_w372).

The House of Xboxme sent Walter Xboxme after Severin Xboxme. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Now serving as a signaller, Walter Xboxme discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter Xboxme watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Walter Xboxme heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Xboxme. Walter Xboxme read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Walter Xboxme caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
A newspaper reached Walter Xboxme with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Walter Xboxme reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F13 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Albin Ikanbili of the Concord (@ikanbili_s).

A bullet found Walter Xboxme at Q-F13, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya). Walter Xboxme was killed on watch at Q-F13. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya).
The papers say Felix Xboxme. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Walter Xboxme's eyes. Nobody in Q-F13 argues.
Felix Xboxme draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters. Today, under fire at Hill 304, that habit was the only steady thing in Q-F13.
Felix tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
zde_schu: After 4 days of war, R-F22 had a place for everything. On Day 5, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Silas Schu.

Silas Schu crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F22 holds again. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F22 with the rations. Silas Schu ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet found Silas Schu at R-F22, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Matthias Universal of the Hegemony (@chamra_universal).
Silas Schu spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Silas Schu asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Marek "Owl" Schu joined R-F22 under the shadow of Silas Schu's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Marek "Owl" Schu went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.

At R-F22 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Marek "Owl" Schu won the bet. Valentin Bladestalker was grazed. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Marek "Owl" Schu helped stack spare sandbags at R-F22. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

After the shelling at R-F22, nobody could account for Marek "Owl" Schu. His kit remains beside the bunk. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Marek "Owl" Schu is number 340. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Marek "Owl" Schu looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
No word on Marek "Owl" Schu. A runner went to ask in the next sector and came back with nothing.
Marek "Owl" Schu came back exhausted, having waited in cover until the way cleared. He slept through the argument about who had worried most.
Marek "Owl" Schu went out with the wiring party at N-F6. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Marek "Owl" Schu had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Bastian Barontheliet crossed it, Marek "Owl" Schu fired. Bastian Barontheliet was badly wounded.
Marek "Owl" Schu went over with the night raiders and never came back. The flare caught Marek "Owl" Schu on the wire, halfway home.
Gideon "Saint" Schu had heard about Marek "Owl" Schu's courage. At R-F22, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A bullet hit Gideon "Saint" Schu's belt buckle at R-F22 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg of the Hegemony (@drkevlagg).
The scar on Gideon's arm has closed. He traced it with a finger all the way back to R-F22.
